record.category: premium-account reseller (Thai: per-host accounts in THB, bank-transfer fulfilment)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Catalogue prices: 'Rapidgator premium account 30 วัน ฿ 690.00', 'Fileboom premium account 30 วัน ฿ 890.00', and 'Fileboom premium account Pro 30 วัน' above those.
free_tier.notes: Four products on the best-seller page; the shop is a LnwShop storefront.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; the host's cap applies (the Rapidgator listing advertises 1 TB total download)

retention.stated: not applicable: the account is the customer's own host account once upgraded

egress.terms: The host's own allowance, restated in Thai: 'สามารถดาวน์โหลดได้ทั้งหมด 1 TB' for the 30-day Rapidgator account, one device at a time: 'สามารถใช้งานได้ครั้งละ 1 เครื่องเท่านั้น'.

record.interface_detail: Buy on the web store; the account or code arrives by email ('จัดส่ง Rapidgator premium account ให้ทาง Email').
record.tooling: Nothing to install; the buyer then uses the host's web download or IDM (the shop also sells IDM licences at ฿750).
record.chaining: Thailand's retrieval layer is resale, not aggregation: one account per host, bought in baht. It does not compose with a debrid, and it is the only way to reach a host from a Thai card that the host's own checkout refuses.
record.limits_note: The product page warns that some Thai ISPs block premium-account use ('อินเตอร์เน็ตบางสถานที่ อาทิ หอพัก, บริษัท, สถานศึกษา ... อาจมีการตั้งค่าป้องกันการใช้งาน Premium account').
record.binding_note: 1 TB per 30 days is just under the 1 TiB monthly volume, so a second account or a second host is required in the same month.

identity_cost.detail: Fulfilment is a Thai bank transfer: the shop runs a 'แจ้งชำระเงิน' (payment-notification) page with 'รายละเอียดการโอนเงิน' and lists only a mobile number and a Gmail address for contact. No card or PayPal rail is named on the product or payment pages.

record.reliability_note: The shop disclaims all responsibility if the underlying host fails ('เว็บไซต์ดังกล่าวขัดข้อง/หยุดให้บริการ ทางร้านไม่รับเปลี่ยนหรือคืนเงินทุกกรณี'), and delivery depends on a human confirming a transfer.
record.confidence_note: Catalogue, product and payment pages read. The absence of a card rail is an observation about those three pages, not proof that none exists at checkout.

record.price_per_tb_month: THB 690 per 30 days for a 1 TB Rapidgator account; THB 890 for Fileboom
record.notes: Thailand has no local premium-link generator that the Thai-language queries surfaced; the market buys foreign host accounts from a Thai storefront instead. That absence is the finding: the Thai layer is a shop, not a service. Trigger condition: a Thai PLG with published pricing appears.
